title: U.S. Measles Deaths Reported | MedPage Today
snippet:
The 2026 tally is overwhelmingly homegrown and unvaccinated, with 94% of cases related to the domestic outbreaks and only 16 among international visitors to the U.S. Nearly all confirmed measles cases this year -- 94% -- have been in people who are unvaccinated or have unknown vaccination status, as vaccine rates declined in recent years. The national MMR vaccination rate among U.S. kindergarteners fell from 95.2% in the 2019-2020 school year to 92.4% in 2025-2026, according to the CDC. And the [...] The latest CDC data for 2026 show 2,777 confirmed cases in the U.S. stemming from 36 outbreaks across 45 states -- the highest total since 1991, when nearly 10,000 cases were confirmed. Last year the nation tallied 2,289 confirmed cases, including three deaths, the first in more than a decade. [...] Medical News
